samples.question: Compare the largest axis-aligned square that fits inside the plate with the plate's own width, and report which of the three bands it falls in. The plate is the single solid dark slate-grey shape on the sheet; the pale grey body, the grey ticks, the grey rings and the thin border are decoration and are never measured. A fitted square must be axis-aligned, that is not rotated, and must lie entirely inside the plate; touching the plate's edge is allowed. Let S be the side of the largest such square, and let W be the plate's full width, the horizontal distance from its leftmost to its rightmost point. Use exactly these rules: less_than_third if S is smaller than W/3; third_to_half if S is at least W/3 and at most W/2; more_than_half if S is larger than W/2. Answer with one label: less_than_third, third_to_half or more_than_half.
